title: Frequent restarting
symptom: AndroidAPS frequently restarts (assumed crashing) at random intervals not more than 30 minutes on a OnePlus 6T. Nightscout server synchronization also fails until the app is force-stopped, cache cleared, and restarted, needing to be done multiple times per day.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. One user found that enabling 'Allow background activity' for AAPS stopped the restarts, suggesting the OS was restricting background activity.
fix: Enabling the 'Allow background activity' setting for AAPS resolved the restarts for one user (Kaapeli64). Another suggestion was to disable Google Play Services, but that was not confirmed as a fix.
evidence_quote: Well, I stumbled into this "Allow background activity" setting, enabled it for AAPS, and now I don't see restarts any more.
